description.value:
Yesodium is matter that has not fully collapsed into identity. It remembers being ore before it chose a form, and it can be convinced to become iron, steel, copper, silver, gold, an exotic alloy or a conductive arcane metal — never organic matter, never anything living. It must be stabilized while it is shaped, and a forge that rushes it gets slag.

Metastable proto-ore from the Yesod impact strata; the one primary vein in the known world runs under Khezek Tor. What is forged from it keeps a memory of the forging, and under enough strain it can remember being something else.
